raw:
Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator incorrectly concluded that the request was satisfied after WebSurfer only navigated to a specific gene region page (ENSCAFG00845015183) on the Ensembl website. The user asked for the link to the "files" (implying the whole genome assembly or download links) relevant in May 2020. The URL provided by the Orchestrator points to a specific genomic coordinate (r=X:24550462-24552226) rather than the main genome browser page or the download section where the actual genome files (FASTA, GTF, etc.) for the assembly "ROS_Cfam_1.0" (released around that time) would be located. The Orchestrator failed to verify that the specific URL provided actually contained the requested genome files and prematurely terminated the task without extracting the correct download links or the main browser URL.
